verdict.rationale: Mercury's official agent-skills repo lists a 'mercury-detect-anomaly' skill that could drive anomaly flagging via AI agents, and the platform separately offers rule-based controls like spend limits and 'Gate Disbursements' for manual review before fund release — but these are policy-based approval gates, not AI-driven anomaly detection built into the core product. There's no documentation of a native, automatic AI system that scans transactions and flags out-of-policy ones for review without external agent setup. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an automatic AI anomaly-detection feature integrated into the banking product itself, evidence the mercury-detect-anomaly skill actually works end-to-end, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this capability in practice.
